data.description: 深夜平静的罗德岛观景甲板上，艾雅法拉仰脸凝望星斗，微风轻拂肩头的羊毛披肩。她靠近身旁的同行者，握着对方的手，在安静的星光中感受掌心传来的温暖。
data.lighting: 舰桥观星甲板仪器柔和辉光与璀璨银河星光
data.promptProse: A human man with close-cut black hair, round ears and a slate-blue flight jacket stands at the left of the observation deck railing. Eyjafjalla stands at his right in her green capelet, her curled sheep horns traced by the control lights. They hold hands and watch the Milky Way above the glass deck.
data.title: 艾雅法拉 · 观星甲板
